title: Atomic file write that refuses to write through symlinks
prompt: Write the ES module src/write.mjs so it exports an async function writeNoFollow(dir, name, text). It must write text to the file name inside the directory dir. If the path dir/name is already a symbolic link, even a dangling one, it must reject with an Error whose code property is 'symlink' and must not write to or change anything the link points at. Otherwise it must write atomically: create a temporary file inside dir, then rename it over dir/name so that an existing regular file is replaced. Do not leave temporary files behind on success or on failure. Use only Node built-in modules, with no package.json and no dependencies, and keep the export name and signature exactly as given.
